meta.purpose: live measurement of IsoGameCharacter.DrinkFluid against the dataset's per-container fluid columns (slice 01 open question 11)

atomic_tolerance.why: Nutrition and Stats are float32; the delta is a difference of two of them, so the band scales with the store, not with the delta

drift_rates.hunger: 9.6e-6 * (1 - hunger) per game-second, 0 while FOOD_EATEN >= 1 (body-stats.md, M)

meta.drift_use: the outer stats.get bracket's tolerance is widened by the maximum passive movement over its own measured worldAge window; no measured number is ever corrected by it
meta.world_changes: none -- no settimespeed, no sandbox write. The primings and the spawned cans live in this run's COPY of the fixture.

pop2_whole.note: 0.3 L of Cola drunk to the bottom: isolates the litres weighting -- 400 kcal/L x 0.3 L = 120, against the 400 a per-item reading of the column would give
pop2_whole.pre_existing: no item Base.Pop2 in admin's inventory

pop2_half.note: a second, full can at f = 0.5: isolates f, and pins that f is a share of the CONTENTS (removeFluid(getAmount() * f)) -- a full can must be left at 0.15 L
pop2_half.rcon_additem: Item Base.Pop2 Added in admin's inventory.

juicebox_whole.note: 0.2 L of JuiceGrape: a different fluid AND a different capacity, so a coincidence in the Cola rows cannot survive it -- 400 kcal/L x 0.2 L = 80
juicebox_whole.pre_existing: no item Base.JuiceBox in admin's inventory

calories.basis: FluidContainer.getProperties() = per-litre x fluid_fill_litres (recalculateCaches @234-@250 L632), read live before the drink

lipids.basis: FluidContainer.getProperties() = per-litre x fluid_fill_litres (recalculateCaches @234-@250 L632), read live before the drink

proteins.basis: FluidContainer.getProperties() = per-litre x fluid_fill_litres (recalculateCaches @234-@250 L632), read live before the drink

hungerChange.basis: FluidContainer.getProperties() = per-litre x fluid_fill_litres (recalculateCaches @234-@250 L632), read live before the drink

thirstChange.basis: FluidContainer.getProperties() = per-litre x fluid_fill_litres (recalculateCaches @234-@250 L632), read live before the drink

hunger.basis: dataset[hunger_change_per_container] x 0.01 x f  (the /100 the fluid script loader applies: FluidDefinitionScript.getHungerChange @0-@10 L186)

thirst.basis: dataset[thirst_change_per_container] x 0.01 x f  (the /100 the fluid script loader applies: FluidDefinitionScript.getHungerChange @0-@10 L186)

amount.basis: removeFluid(getAmount() * f) on a full container

calories.basis: the no-drift expectation, banded by the maximum passive movement over the measured window

carbs.basis: the no-drift expectation, banded by the maximum passive movement over the measured window

lipids.basis: the no-drift expectation, banded by the maximum passive movement over the measured window

proteins.basis: the no-drift expectation, banded by the maximum passive movement over the measured window

hunger.basis: the no-drift expectation, banded by the maximum passive movement over the measured window

thirst.basis: the no-drift expectation, banded by the maximum passive movement over the measured window

amount_after.basis: removeFluid(getAmount() * f): f is a share of the CONTENTS, so a full container is left holding (1 - f) x fill

atomic_window_game_hours.basis: both snapshots are taken inside one Lua call, so the window must be 0. The band is 1e-5 game-hours = 0.036 game-seconds -- far below one tick (0.27 game-s at 60 fps on this fixture's 16.03 game-s/real-s clock), so a genuine tick advance fails it while float noise does not; at that width the calorie drift it could hide is 6e-4 kcal. TK.json rounds to 6 decimals, so anything under 5e-7 game-hours reads back as exactly 0

food_timer.basis: (int)(timer + |hungerChange x f| * 13000), DrinkFluid @254-@286 L5896-L5897 -- the cast truncates the WHOLE sum. Band 1.0 = one truncation unit (see the comment)

outer_window.spans: the bus round trips around the command plus DRINK_SETTLE
